preconditions.description: Grid dimensions n and m are between 3 and 30, and k (number of copies) is between 0 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(len(picture) == n and all(len(row) == m and all(c in '01' for c in row) for row in picture) for picture in pictures)
preconditions.description: Each picture is an n×m matrix of '0's and '1's, with exactly k+1 pictures provided.
The total number of pictures is exactly k+1 (k copies + initial picture).

postconditions.expression: initial_index in range(1, k + 2) and all(picture_indices.count(i) == 1 for i in range(1, k + 2))
postconditions.description: The initial picture index is valid, and each picture index from 1 to k+1 appears exactly once in the output.

postconditions.expression: len(operations) == q + 1 and operations[0] == initial_index and all(op[0] in {1, 2} for op in operations[1:])
postconditions.description: The output starts with the initial picture index followed by exactly q operations, each being either a recolor (1 x y) or copy (2 i) operation.

postconditions.expression: all(1 < op[1] < n and 1 < op[2] < m for op in operations if op[0] == 1)
postconditions.description: Every recolor operation targets a non-border cell (x, y) where 1 < x < n and 1 < y < m.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= op[1] <= k + 1 for op in operations if op[0] == 2)
postconditions.description: Every copy operation assigns a valid picture index i (1 ≤ i ≤ k+1).

postconditions.expression: all(is_valid_recolor(get_current_picture(operations[:idx], pictures), op[1], op[2]) for idx, op in enumerate(operations, 1) if op[0] == 1)
postconditions.description: Every recolor operation (1 x y) is valid: the cell (x, y) is surrounded by four cells of opposite color at the time of the operation.

postconditions.expression: all(pictures[op[1] - 1] == get_current_picture(operations[:idx], pictures) for idx, op in enumerate(operations, 1) if op[0] == 2)
postconditions.description: Every copy operation (2 i) assigns the current picture state to index i, matching the provided pictures.

postconditions.expression: all(pictures[i - 1] == get_current_picture(operations[:idx], pictures) for i, idx in enumerate([1] + [j for j, op in enumerate(operations, 1) if op[0] == 2], 1))
postconditions.description: The sequence of operations reproduces the given pictures, with the initial picture and all copies correctly assigned.
